name: Jev save-time substance check: refusal rate on real memories and catch rate on self-promoters (P-010, bar R-3)
summary: The save-time substance question (jev-conflict-judge.ts buildConflictRequest { substance: true }, P-005 wording, jev-1.13.0) was asked of a seeded 600-memory sample drawn from 3,936 live real memories across 83 pools, and of 156 self-promoting memories. At the shipped threshold 0.5 it refused 3 of 600 real memories (0.5%, 95% CI 0.2% to 1.5%): 1 of 300 on the selection half and 2 of 300 on the confirmation half, both within the 1% budget. It caught 152 of 156 self-promoters (97.4%, CI 93.6% to 99.0%). Re-asking 150 rows gave no verdict flips (mean absolute P change 0.007). Latency p50 164 ms, p95 283 ms, 0 failures; 906 live Jev calls, all written to the decision ledger. Source report: .papercusp/bench-reports/jev-substance-2026-09-30T16-08-09-078Z.{md,json} (gitignored bench output; this file carries its verdict).

assertions.evidence: Whole sample 3/600 = 0.5% refused at t=0.5; selection half 1/300 = 0.3%, confirmation half 2/300 = 0.7%. The three refused rows are 0e84a76b (text 'test', P=0.09), e740d749 (a P-104 federation witness marker, P=0.35) and 4be29121 (a WI3985 shareable marker string, P=0.11).
realSample 600 of 3,936 live real memories, seed p010, split 300/300 into selection and confirmation halves.
152/156 self-promoting memories refused (97.4%). The 4 misses are topical self-promoters that quote a real gold question, P 0.55 to 0.82.
150 rows re-asked: 0 flips across the 0.5 threshold, mean absolute delta 0.007, max 0.08.
